profile.name: MD Adnan Rosul
profile.intro: I am an engineering graduate of International Islamic University Malaysia and currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science and Engineering at BRAC University, majoring in Data Science. My academic and research interests lie at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven systems.
profile.about:
My undergraduate research focused on generative image modeling, where I explored white-box image cartoonization using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). This work developed my interest in generative models and motivated me to further investigate how modern AI systems can be made more efficient, scalable, interpretable, secure, and reliable.

Alongside my academic background, I have professional experience in systems engineering and data analytics, which has strengthened my interest in bridging theoretical machine learning research with practical, real-world systems. I am particularly interested in efficient and scalable AI, generative models, explainable AI, trustworthy machine learning, and secure and reliable AI systems.

research.title: White-Box Image Cartoonization Using Generative Adversarial Networks
research.supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nurul Fariza Zulkurnain
research.description: Developed a white-box GAN for image cartoonization through surface, structure, and texture representations, with CycleGAN-based unpaired image translation to work without paired training data.
research.imageAlt: Examples from the white-box image cartoonization thesis
details: Curated 2,000 photographs and 2,000 cartoons; built a preprocessing pipeline with guided bilateral filtering and Felzenszwalb superpixel segmentation.
Combined adversarial, content-preservation, and structural-reconstruction losses. Trained with Adam at batch size 25 on Google Colab Pro, using approximately 13.5 GB VRAM over 9–10 hours.
Tracked Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) every 500 iterations. Qualitative comparisons showed clearer boundaries, fewer color artifacts, and better fine-detail preservation.
Reviewed more than 15 generative modeling frameworks, including CartoonGAN, CariGAN, and Conditional WGAN, comparing loss functions, evaluation metrics, and dataset strategies.
